data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme following Energy theme.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio that is invested predominantly in equity and equity related securities of companies engaged in Energy and Energy related activities. However, there is no assurance that the objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity Related Securities of companies engaged in Energy (Traditional/New) and allied sectors & activities - 80% - 100% Equity and Equity Related securities of companies other than those engaged in Energy and allied sectors & activities - 0-20% Debt/Money Market Instruments - 0-20% Units of InvITs - 0-10%
data.exit_load: For redemption / switch out within 90 days from the date of allotment: 0.5% • If units are redeemed or switched out on or after 90 days from the date of allotment - Nil
